system.vapour_pressure: Antoine, log10(p / mmHg) = A - B / (C + t / C); 1 mmHg = 133.322368 Pa

liquid_activity.tau: tau12 = a12 + b12_K / T, tau21 = a21 + b21_K / T, T in K; G = exp(-alpha tau); component 1 is the light one

system.enthalpy: liquid h = sum x_i cp_liquid_i (T - 298.15 K); vapour H = sum y_i [cp_liquid_i (Tb_i - 298.15 K) + dH_vap_nbp_i + cp_vapour_i (T - Tb_i)], Tb_i the normal boiling point from the Antoine equation; heats of mixing neglected
system.liquid_density: ideal mixing of volumes; each pure liquid rho_i = density_20C_i (1 - expansion_i (T - 20 C))

column.feed_enters: as liquid onto the tray of the nozzle in use

insulation.loss: UA (tray liquid temperature - ambient temperature TI001), taken from the vapour-liquid mixture on that tray

condenser.products: reflux leaves the drum as saturated liquid in equilibrium with the vapour distillate at the drum pressure; the distillate meter and the distillate sample are on the vapour line after the product cooler, so both see the vapour distillate

reboiler.heating: saturated steam at 143.6 C (4.0 bar a), latent heat 2133 kJ/kg, condensate leaves saturated
reboiler.kettle_heat_loss: 2.0 % of the duty taken up by the process side

laboratory.points: feed, distillate, bottoms, tray sample valves
laboratory.product_samples: taken after the product coolers, below 35 C

tray_samples.how: through the sample cooler at tray pressure into a closed vial
